$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$root = 'C:\Users\harsh\.cursor\projects\empty-window'
$result = Join-Path $root 'DEPLOY_AGENT_RESULT.txt'

function W([string]$text) {
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $result -Encoding utf8 -Value $text
}

Remove-Item -LiteralPath $result -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
W "DEPLOY_AGENT_RESULT - $(Get-Date -Format o)"
W ""

# 1) Path
W "=== 1. Test-Path ==="
$exists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $root
W "Test-Path '$root' : $exists"
if (-not $exists) {
    W "FATAL: project path missing."
    exit 1
}
Set-Location -LiteralPath $root

# 2) npm install
W ""
W "=== 2. npm install ==="
$logInstall = Join-Path $root 'npm-install-full.log'
npm install *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $logInstall

W "--- tail npm-install-full.log (last 50 lines) ---"
Get-Content -LiteralPath $logInstall -Tail 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { W $_ }

# 3) backend build
W ""
W "=== 3. npm run build -w backend ==="
$logBe = Join-Path $root 'build-backend-full.log'
npm run build -w backend *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $logBe

# 4) frontend build

npm run build -w frontend *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $logFe

# 5) If either build failed: stop here (fix TS/packages, re-run script)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    W ""
    W "BUILD FAILED (frontend was last). Fix errors using logs above, then re-run this script from step 2 or clean and rebuild."
}

# 6) git init if needed
W ""
W "=== 6. git init (if no .git) ==="

    git init -b main 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { W $_ }
    W "git_init_exit: $LASTEXITCODE"

    W ".git already exists; skipped git init"
}

W ""

$st | ForEach-Object { W $_ }

# 8) commit
W ""
W "=== 8. git commit ==="
git commit -m "feat: Bobakuma India e-commerce monorepo" 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { W $_ }
W "git_commit_exit: $LASTEXITCODE"

# 9) remote
W ""

git remote get-url origin 2>&1 | Out-Null

    git remote add origin https://github.com/Harshit181003/BobakumaIndia.git 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { W $_ }
    W "remote_add_exit: $LASTEXITCODE"
} else {
    W "origin already set: $(git remote get-url origin)"
}

# 10) push
W ""
W "=== 10. git push -u origin main ==="
git push -u origin main 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { W $_ }
W "git_push_exit: $LASTEXITCODE"
W ""
W "=== END ==="
